llama-server.notes: First runtime. Use --jinja for current llama.cpp chat template/tool-call handling. The baseline disables automatic mmproj download for text-only prompting.

ollama.notes: Useful comparison runtime after the llama-server baseline.

lm-studio.notes: Useful UI/runtime comparison when testing downloaded GGUFs manually.

qwen3.5-9b-q4_k_m.notes: Default 16 GB Mac baseline: good quality without the memory pressure of Q8/BF16.

qwen3.5-9b-iq4_xs.notes: Smaller/faster comparison quant if Q4_K_M is too tight.

gemma-4-12b-qat.notes: Gemma 4 QAT (quantization-aware trained, near-bf16 quality) via Unsloth's Dynamic 2.0 UD-Q4_K_XL — higher accuracy AND smaller (~6.7 GB) than Google's plain Q4_0, which Unsloth found degrades quality. Dense 12B, 256K ctx, native system role + function calling. Best Gemma fit for a 16 GB Mac. Pass --no-mmproj-auto (default here) for text-only. Sampling set to temp 0.3 for reliable tool calls (Gemma's documented chat default is temp 1.0/top_p 0.95/top_k 64 — raise temp for more creative prose). Google's official GGUF: google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf.

gemma-4-e4b-qat.notes: Lighter Gemma 4 QAT (Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL, ~4.2 GB): effective 4.5B (8B total via Per-Layer Embeddings). Snappier turns / more KV headroom on a 16 GB Mac when the 12B is too tight. Google's official GGUF: google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf.

local-gguf.notes: Set LLAMA_MODEL_SOURCE=path and LLAMA_MODEL_PATH to use your own GGUF.

simple.system: You are a concise local agent test model. Follow the user's instruction exactly and be explicit about assumptions.

agentic-smoke.system: You are testing agentic behavior. Think in terms of goal, plan, action, observation, and final answer, but keep the final response concise.

curl.notes: Use curl examples in README for raw API checks.

pi.notes: Node CLI agent. Setup merges a 'localai' provider (ctx 131072 / maxTokens 4096) plus compaction (reserveTokens 4096, keepRecentTokens 49152). Run pins --provider/--model and appends agents/pi/system.md via --append-system-prompt (context-economy rules: no data-file reads, grep-first, range reads).

qwen-agent.notes: Python framework. The example registers a calculator tool to demo function calling.
